newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at record high, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at record high, more gains seen.

text.p: The FTSE 100 closed at a record high on Wednesday as both share and bond investors hoped UK interest rates would not be raised in the near-term.
A weak start on Wall Street pushed prices off their best level late in the session but dealers expect the FTSE to set new highs in the coming weeks provided the Dow remains steady.
The FTSE 100 also set an intraday trading high of 4,227.5 before closing at 4,219.1, up 23.6 points on the day, surpassing the previous record closing high of 4,207.7, set on January 17.
"The Dow took a bit of steam out of the market but people are still pretty confident," one senior dealer said.
